productTitle: Pour Over Ceramic, Coffee Dripper Ceramic Coffee Maker,White
reviewTitle: Easy to clean and makes a clean tasting cup
review:
Got this a few days ago and have used it twice so far. It works the way I hoped. I put a #2 cone in with a medium grind, and the water moved through at a steady pace.

The coffee tasted clean and bright, not bitter. Pouring slowly gave me decent control over how wet the grounds got, which I liked. It sat on my 15 oz mug without wobbling.

Cleanup is the best part for me. I just tap out the grounds, give it a quick rinse, and I'm done. I need that on school mornings when I have about two minutes to spare.
